content.title: UDR (UDR): $25.3M One-Off Gain Raises Earnings Quality Questions as Margins Slip
content.summary: UDR (UDR) posted a net profit margin of 7.4%, coming in just below last year’s 7.9% and reflecting the impact of a $25.3 million one-off gain in the latest 12 months. Looking ahead, the company’s earnings are forecast to grow by 8.27% annually, while revenue is projected to rise by 3.5% per year. This lags behind the broader US market rate of 10.3%.
